title: Canning Town Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to nearest 24-hour A&E hospitals, urgent care, hazards, and emergency supplies in Canning Town.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 immediately. For power outages call 105; for gas leaks call 0800 111 999.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Newham University Hospital: Glen Road, Plaistow, E13 8SL. Travel from Canning Town station: ~20 min walk northeast along Barking Road and Prince Regent Lane, or bus 147, 241, or 473.
- The Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Whitechapel Road, Whitechapel, E1 1FR. Travel from Canning Town station: ~25 min via bus 115 west along East India Dock Road (A13) and Commercial Road.

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Newham Urgent Treatment Centre: co-located with Newham University Hospital, Glen Road, Plaistow, E13 8SL.
- Homerton University Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Homerton Row, E9 6SR.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- River Thames, Bow Creek (lower River Lea), and the Royal Docks (Royal Victoria Dock) surround the area; low-lying terrain and road underpasses near the Silvertown Flyover and A13/A1020 junction present severe water pooling risks during storm surges.

4. Emergency Supplies:
Pharmacies and large supermarkets along Barking Road, Silvertown Way, and Western Gateway supply drinking water, non-prescription medicines, and basic first-aid gear.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
